name: core-commerce
description: Stock and Holds on a table, D70 and D103's step 4, through the contract Supply: a cart's lines and a to-one relation take units as the claim enters a takeOn state, every item or none, and commit, release and return them as it moves; a direct call of a supply's operation is not_requested unless it changes nothing; two claims for the last unit, one of which holds it, each a take that takes the supply's lock; a delete of a claim releasing what it holds and leaving what it committed sold, and a claim created again with the key holding afresh; Stock's counts and its ledger, paged newest first; and each one's define refusals. Cases written by hand in the recorded format. Each answer holds what the replayer compares: a record's id, data and behaviors, an operation's result, a refusal whole, in the core's words; what only the engine's store answers (sequence numbers, versions, timestamps, the document a define echoes) is left out.
